title: Nourishing Syrian Pork Back Ribs Ssam Wrap
description: A winey, chewy, comforting Syrian dish featuring pork back ribs, ssam-wrap, and low-carb-friendly ingredients, cooked in a paella-pan.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large paella-pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the pork back ribs to the paella-pan, browning them on all sides.
Add the red wine, pomegranate molasses, lemon juice, and sumac to the paella-pan, stirring to combine.
Cover the paella-pan with aluminum foil and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the pork back ribs for 2 hours, or until tender and falling off the bone.
While the pork is cooking, prepare the ssam wrap by cutting it into 8-10 pieces.
To assemble the ssam wrap, place a few pieces of the pork back ribs onto a piece of ssam wrap, garnished with chopped parsley.
